sources.title: Pika H3 Flex — Faster-than-real-time video model
sources.snippet: Pika H3 Flex is our post-trained MiniMax H3 model, built for professional iteration. It generates faster than real time, works with up to 12 references, exports three separate audio stems, finishes at up to 4K, and ships with open weights.
